description:
Decode a ready logic capture of the session (browser or bench). protocol "uart" with channels {rx} and options
    {baud (300-1000000, 9600), bits (5-9, 8), parity (none, even, odd), stop (1, 2), invert (false)}; "spi" with
    {sck, mosi?, miso?, cs?} (one data pin at least) and options {mode (0-3, 0), bit_order (msb, lsb), bits (8)};
    "i2c" with {scl, sda}. channels are pins of the capture. Returns {capture, protocol, frames, next, problems}, 2000
    frames from offset. uart frames {t_us, value, error?} (framing, parity) and text, the printable bytes of the page;
    spi {t_us, mosi?, miso?} per word, while cs is low when given; i2c {t_us, kind (start, restart, address, data,
    stop), value?, rw?, ack?}. problems: what makes the decoding doubtful.
name: decode_capture
title: Decode a capture
